contentList.content: Bind the weapons in both your main hand and off-hand. You become proficient with them, and they use your Spellcasting Ability Modifier for attack and damage rolls, gain a +2 enchantment bonus, and deal scaling Force damage.
Your bond with your weapon deepens. You can attack three times, instead of twice, whenever you take the Attack action with your pact weapon.
You achieve ultimate mastery with your pact weapon. You can attack four times whenever you take the Attack action.
When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, it takes additional Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma Modifier plus [1], and you regain hit points equal to your Charisma Modifier.
Your martial strikes are suffused with planar magic. You add your Charisma Modifier to weapon damage rolls.
When you hit a target with your Pact Weapon, you can cast Eldritch Blast as a Bonus Action until the end of your turn.
Unleash eldritch power with your off-hand following a successful melee strike.
Your off-hand crackles with eldritch energy. You can cast Eldritch Blast as a Bonus Action.

This weapon is bound to its master. It uses the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier for attack and damage rolls, gains a +2 enchantment bonus, and deals additional Force damage based on your level.
Deal additional Necrotic damage to the hexed target whenever you hit it with an attack.
